ACOE_WE_2026.label: Assyrian Church of the East, Diocese of Western Europe — Ecclesiastical Calendar 2026
ACOE_WE_2026.notes: MISLABELLED UNTIL 2026-09-05. Registered as COFE_2026, "English Calendar 2026", an "anglican_calendar_reference" -- on the strength of the filename alone, its own note conceding "exact source label to be refined if used." The file is not an English Anglican calendar. Its title page reads "Holy Apostolic Catholic Assyrian Church of the East, Diocese of Western Europe -- Ecclesiastical Calendar 2026", with the Syriac heading above it and Mar Awa III and Mar Awraham Youkhanis named on the following pages. It is a Church of the East DIOCESAN calendar, the same kind of witness as the ACOE Diocese of California calendars that carried the 59 COE confirmations on 2026-09-03. No confirmation ever rested on it under the wrong label, but a future session looking for an Anglican witness would have found it and cited it.

HAPGOOD.label: Hapgood, Service Book of the Holy Orthodox-Catholic Apostolic (Greco-Russian) Church, 1906
HAPGOOD.path: NOT IN REPO -- archive.org item ServiceBookOfHolyOrthodoxChurchByHapgood; Appendix B pp.592-615 supplied by Josh as an upload 2026-09-04
HAPGOOD.notes: Public domain (Emory/Pitts digitisation states the online edition is not protected by copyright). Slavic recension, matching Charter section 9's implemented baseline. Approved by Josh 2026-09-04 as the governing source for Byzantine explanatory content in data/explanations/byzantine.json. Appendix B is the book's own numbered explanation apparatus. LIMITS, from Hapgood's own Preface: she omitted even the skeleton of the Midnight Service and Little Vespers, and left Vespers largely in skeleton form -- so Appendix B does not explain the Midnight Office or either Compline. Not a hymnographic source; Lambertsen remains the governing source for this lane's hymnography.
